newsitem.title: USA: R&B sees debt reduction aiding 2nd half net.
newsitem.headline: R&B sees debt reduction aiding 2nd half net.

text.p: R&B Inc said Friday it is "well ahead" of its plan to reduce debt, and that should enhance its earnings for the second half of the year.
The company also said it is confident it can remain on plan for the balance of the year.
The company said its efficiencies and improvements in working capital have allowed it to reduce debt by $7 million.
In addition, it said 1997 should be a "pivotal year" in its effort to restore a more consistent pattern of profitable growth.
The company reported net income for the second quarter of $0.28 per share compared with $0.24 per share for the same period a year ago.
The company said it had a "modest" net sales increase, which was in line with its expectations and the overall growth of the automotive aftermarket industry.
The company reported net sales of $41 million compared with $39.7 million.
